hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Reset the count "turnInNormal".
Call arg.

Count up "turnInNormal".
If the enemy is ready to act and the count "turnInNormal" is at least 5, then choose state 21 next and stop.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of the enemy.
If hpRate is at most 60 and not the register's 'isTransitDefenseForReminingHpRate', then
  Set the register's 'isTransitDefenseForReminingHpRate' to true.
  Choose state 24 next and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If hpRate is at most 30 and util passes a fraction roll of 20, then choose state 24 next and stop.
  If util passes a fraction roll of 25, then choose state 21 next and stop.
  The enemy → without-and-lot-and-register-ability.

flow.text: the enemy is ready to act and the count "turnInNormal" is at least 5
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of the enemy.
hpRate is at most 60 and not the register's 'isTransitDefenseForReminingHpRate'
the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: hpRate is at most 30 and util passes a fraction roll of 20
util passes a fraction roll of 25

hooks.logic:
The script register.
Count up "turnInStandby".
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If the count "turnInStandby" is at least 2, then the enemy uses the move labelled "tsunami".
  Otherwise, the enemy → without-and-lot-and-register-ability.

flow.text: the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: The enemy uses the move labelled "tsunami".

hooks.logic:
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If util passes a fraction roll of 25, then
    Choose state 25 next.
    Set the register's 'transitNextStateId' to 21 and stop.
  The enemy → without-and-lot-and-register-ability.

flow.text: the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: util passes a fraction roll of 25

hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Set (the register of arg's 'parent')'s 'transitNextStateId' to 12.

Given arg.
Reset the count "turnInStandby".
Set the register's 'damagedNumByLightning' to 0.
Call arg.

Given arg.
Increase the register's 'damagedNumByLightning' by one.
Set the state settings's 'abilityOptions''s 'sequence' to [[{messageId: data at (the register's 'damagedNumByLightning')}]].
Let v be 13.
If the size of data is the register's 'damagedNumByLightning', then set v to 23.
Set the state settings's 'nextStateId' to v.
Call arg.

the size of data is the register's 'damagedNumByLightning'
Set the state settings's 'nextStateId' to v.

hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Set the state settings's 'nextStateId' to the register's 'transitNextStateId'.
Call arg.

flow.text: Set the state settings's 'nextStateId' to the register's 'transitNextStateId'.
